chat.say: Ab jaldi se shaadi ki shopping kar lete hain!
Ruko, thoda aur sasta hone do!

data.asar: Shaadi shopping walo ke thode paise bachenge.
data.caption:
Shaadi season se theek pehle gold buyers ke liye badi rahat! 🪙✨

• 10 din ke andar gold ₹8,660 sasta ho chuka hai.
• Rates girne se jewellery market mein halchal tezz ho gayi hai.
• Buyers ab sahi mauke ka fayda uthane ki soch rahe hain.

Mummy ready hain par papa bol rahe hain thoda aur ruk jao! 😂

Apne us dost ko tag karo jiski shaadi aane wali hai!
